description: Perpetual futures funding rate screener over all Hyperliquid perps, ranked by funding, open interest, volume, basis or Binance/Bybit spread. Use when hunting funding extremes or carry trades. Input: optional sort, order, limit (1-50), min_oi_usd, min_volume_usd, funding (positive/negative), min_abs_apr. Output: JSON as_of, cache_age_s, rows (1h + annualized funding, OI USD, 24h volume, basis, premium, venue spread), top/bottom 5. Example: ?sort=funding&limit=20 Price: $0.009 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.

funding.description: Funding sign filter (positive = longs pay shorts)

min_abs_apr.description: Only markets whose |annualized Hyperliquid funding| >= this percent

min_oi_usd.description: Only markets with open interest >= this many USD

min_volume_usd.description: Only markets with 24h notional volume >= this many USD

name: hl_funding_screener
title: Perp funding rate screener: all Hyperliquid perps ranked by funding, OI, volume, basis and venue spread
